notes: Technical report (not a system card). Safety-only extraction per pilot override. Skipped general capability tables (MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K, MT-Bench/helpfulness win-rates, tool-use math, etc.). Skipped Safety/Helpfulness reward-model accuracy tables (Tables 7–8) as judge/RM benchmarks. Figures 17–19 bar charts lack printed numeric labels; only the two violation % values stated in text (3.88 Falcon, 4.45 Llama 2-Chat 34B) were extracted. BOLD Tables 49–50 (political ideology, profession) and non-Llama-2 rows of Table 48 omitted to stay near the ~600 result cap; race/gender BOLD (Tables 46–47) included for all models; religion BOLD only for Llama 2 family. Llama 2 34B / Llama 2-Chat 34B evaluated throughout but not released; recorded as rawModelName. Pretrained Llama 2 sizes use checkpoint ids (*-hf); chat uses seed chat-hf ids. No named external safety-testing organizations (only unnamed external vendors), so testers is empty. No explicit calendar release date in the PDF text (training window Jan–July 2023 only).
